name: Ghost Walker Beatrice

intro.text: Gather round, ladies and gentlemen, and listen. In this very lane in 1666... oh, you wanted a fight. Very well, the story can wait.

win: Oh! You've broken the spell. The ghost will be furious. He'll haunt you at breakfast.
after: A good ghost tour is five parts history, three parts legend and two parts cold, damp air.
